name: Marc Bendavid
bio: Marc Bendavid is a Canadian film, television and stage actor best known for his leading role as 'One' (Jace Corso) on the Syfy science-fiction series Dark Matter. Bendavid attended Unionville High School before graduating from the prestigious National Theatre School of Canada in 2004. He has since built a diverse career spanning both gritty dramas and lighthearted television films.
